evidence: The 1990 treating-service report and the 1992 workshop account each describe an arterial gas embolism after rapid decompression in RNZAF training in 1988. Harding provides an 8,000 to 35,000 ft excursion in 2.4 s and residual neurologic deficits. Sutherland provides recompression and flying-training disposition. Neither report supplies a matchable event date or identifier and the treatment report does not give the pressures. Retain the follow-up evidence without incrementing the AGE case count.
